items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Oh, well, did I tell you that we used to play -- at one time the band used to play tricks on each other... So, like Posey... Now, they took Art Whetsel's -- they changed his valves around... So they took -- we had a fiddle player

ctx.x: And then, when we got back on the stand and getting ready to play and he'd pick up his horn and he went to lick it and he jumped almost to the ceiling and ran like mad. That was him.
Now, they took Art Whetsel's -- they changed his valves around and he couldn't blow nothing on it. He didn't know what was wrong with it. That's the second.

So they took -- we had a fiddle player -- Oh, this one particular thing. This prima donna, Ada Ward was her name, the prima donna of the show, and she was trying to get the band fired because the band they had before, she was going with one of the guys in the band. So we said, "We're going to fix her." So Duke had to hire a fiddle player to lead her tunes, you know.
